name: CNC Electronics Inc
old_description: Fanuc parts and repair specialist to the machine tools industries of America and Canada. CNC Electronics Inc are leading independent Fanuc part specialists offering Fanuc parts such as GE Fanuc drives, servo and spindle units, ALPHA and BETA series amplifier module.
about:
CNC Electronics Inc was founded in 2004 in Charlottesville, Virginia, to supply and repair Fanuc components for machine tool users across the Americas. The founders chose the location for its proximity to GE Fanuc Automation, establishing an East Coast hub that now serves thousands of customers in the United States and Canada.

The company specializes in Fanuc drives, servo and spindle amplifiers (including ALPHA and BETA series), control PCBs, power supply units, AC motors, and CNC monitors. It operates an exchange program for emergency breakdowns, a repair service with a typical 24‑ to 48‑hour turnaround, testing, and a surplus channel for obsolete or damaged units. In‑house built CNC monitors for Fanuc, Mazak, and Siemens controls carry a two‑year guarantee, while all Fanuc parts carry a 12‑month warranty. Orders received before 4:30 PM ET ship the same day from a Richmond, Virginia UPS hub.

Customers are primarily machine‑tool builders, job shops, and maintenance departments in the U.S. and Canada that run CNC equipment with Fanuc controls. The firm also directs Western‑region inquiries to a separate affiliate, CNC Electronics West Inc.

The business was started to provide an independent, responsive source for Fanuc parts and repairs, emphasizing quick turnaround, same‑day shipping, and warranty coverage that reduces downtime for manufacturers.
